svg.title: How a cross-domain question is answered: semantic models only, and ontology-grounded
svg.desc: Two evaluation arms answer the same telco question over the same four semantic models. Arm A works from model schemas through the Fabric IQ MCP server and infers the bridges between models. Arm B reads entity types, relationships, metrics and rules from the Fabric IQ ontology, plans the path, runs source-owned measures on each model and combines results by rule. An evaluation harness scores both arms.
svg.text: How a cross-domain question is answered: semantic models only, and ontology-grounded
Same question, same four semantic models, same measures. The difference is where the cross-model meaning comes from, and that difference is measured.

Both arms use the same Fabric permissions, the same AI-prepared semantic models and the same model deployment. The harness reports what it measures; it does not assume that either arm wins.
